text:
two more

Schopenhauer: "It is difficult to find happiness within oneself, but it is impossible to find it anywhere else."

and then from Emerson on Self-Reliance: "Ne te quaesiveris extra" -- "do not seek outside yourself."

quotedTweet.text: "When you cannot find peace within yourself, it is useless to look for it elsewhere." La Rochefoucauld
